Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this contest. Afghanistan have gained vital 10 points and jumped to number 8 in the ICC Men's CWC Super League table. 20 points are still up for grabs for both teams in this series. The second ODI is on Sunday, 23rd January at 12.30 pm IST (7 am GMT). Do join us in advance for all the coverage. Cheers!

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the Afghan skipper, is also the Man of the Match for his sensible knock. Says that it was a satisfying day for them and they played well. Admits that they were 30 runs short but praises his bowlers for doing a commendable job. Shares that the ball was not coming onto the bat in the first innings and the pitch improved for batting in the second half. Appreciates the knock of Rahmat Shah and praises his spinners. Shahidi wants to keep improving and play even better in the next game. He is happy to have four wins in the CWC Super League and hopes to win the next two games as well and finish strongly. Regarding his knock, Shahidi replies that his son wanted him to play well in the first game as captain and he is happy to deliver. Admits that there was a bit of pressure but he learnt a lot from this experience of leading the team. Further says that the ball was staying low so he wanted to bat till the end of the innings as it wouldn't have been easy for the new batters to bat on this track.

Pieter Seelaar, the Dutch skipper, says that there were a couple of chances missed in the field and that hurt them a bit. Feels that they were in the game for quite a long time. Praises the skills of Rashid Khan and Yamin Ahmadzai and calls them too good for Netherlands. Tells that he has no regret of bowling first and adds that at the halfway mark, they were confident about getting the target but feels that they lost Scott Edwards at the wrong time and it was too much to ask from their lower order against quality Afghan bowlers. Lauds the effort of all his bowlers and calls it unfortunate to lose this match. Shares that the conditions were very cold and windy and he hopes to have better weather for the next game. Mentions that they competed well, they have got a bit of match rhythm and would look to do better in the next game. States that with a bit more effort they can get over the line. Finishes by saying that it will be a hard-fought series and there is plenty at stake.
Presentation time...

The Afghan spinners, as expected, choked the flow of runs and bowled with accurate lines. Pieter Seelaar consumed too many balls and scored too little. That mounted pressure and let the required rate slowly go out of reach. Scott Edwards was the nucleus around whom this chase revolved for the Netherlands and as soon as he was sent back by Mujeeb, the writing was on the wall. Seelaar did try to fight hard with debutant Boris Gorlee but they only delayed the inevitable. All in all, it would be fair to say that the Dutch team walked straight into the trap of Afghanistan by staying too patient with the bat and waiting for the opportunity to score runs. It never arrived.

In pursuit, the Netherlands made a confident start to the chase. Scott Edwards showed the right intent to score runs and the pitch also appeared to settle down in the afternoon. They gathered 45 runs in the first 10 overs for the loss of one wicket and had got the perfect platform to express themselves in the middle overs. But after the fall of the first wicket, Afghanistan managed to exert some pressure and grabbed a few quick wickets.

Clinically done in the end by Afghanistan! This was their kind of a game. They knew the conditions better than anyone and their batting innings although raised a few eyebrows, the Afghans knew what they were doing. Afghanistan kept forming stands and didn't care about the scoring rate. The plan though didn't work out to go big at the backend but still, whatever runs they put on the board appeared to be above par on this surface.

OUT! RUN OUT! There it is! The final wicket to end what has been a brilliant game for Afghanistan. Back of a length, around off. Fred Klaassen looks to heave it away but gets the inside edge on the pads. It rolls to the off side and they look for a single. Najibullah Zadran though runs in from point and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Fred Klaassen is short and that is the last wicket. Afghanistan win by 36 runs!
Brandon Glover is the last batsman.

OUT! RUN OUT! Easy decision for the TV umpire this time! Fullish and around off, Vivian Kingma forces it out on the off side. He crosses for a risky single as the bowler misses his shy at the non-striker's end. Vivian Kingma wants the second but is sent back. Meanwhile, Rashid Khan fires a direct hit at the bowler's end from long on as Vivian Kingma tries to drag his bat inside the safety crease. They appeal and the TV umpire is called. Kingma though is seen to be walking off. The replays find him short.
Direct hit at the bowler's end from Rashid Khan. They appeal and the umpire refers it upstairs. Vivian Kingma is not waiting though and starts to walk.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.

Full ball, around off. Kingma looks to block it from the crease but misses. There is a noise as the ball goes past the stumps. The Afghan players enquire if it clipped the stumps this time but the umpire is not interested.
Length ball, wide outside off. Slapped to sweeper cover for one.
Back of a length, on off. Fred Klaassen defends it from the back foot.
Full, on off. Blocked back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, outside off. Kingma tries to defend but misses as the ball spins away.

Kingma is safe! Tossed up, lands outside off and comes back in. Kingma looks to block but it sneaks through the gate. It goes very close to the off pole and since there are no bails, it's tough to give it bowled. Rashid though is appealing. The umpires have a word. The TV umpire is called in and after looking at it from various angles, there is no concrete evidence to suggest that it clipped the off stump.

What happened there? Rashid Khan seems sure that the ball has hit the stumps and the batter is bowled. Just a reminder, there are no bails due to the strong wind blowing across the field. The third umpire is referred to check whether the off stump got deflected. A tough call to make, nothing conclusive in the replays. The benefit of the doubt goes to Vivian Kingma.
Vivian Kingma is in next.
OUT! BOWLED! Through the gate! Googly, lands on off and comes back in. Philippe Boissevain looks to block but it sneaks through the gate and hits the stumps.

Good commitment in the deep! Tossed up, on off. Pushed to the right of the bowler and the batters set off. Rashid gets across and then fires the ball at his end but misses. The ball goes to the left of long off but the fielder sprints across, dives and stops it. Three taken in the end.
Philippe Boissevain takes a step down the track and eases it past cover for one.
A single to end Mujeeb Ur Rahman's spell as this is worked past square leg. He ends with figures of 10-1-39-2.
Darted on the pads. Philippe Boissevain looks to work it away but gets the leading edge. It goes in the air but drops well short of the cover-point fielder.
Loopy ball, on off. Fred works it to long off for another single.
A single again as this time it is worked to long off.
Fired on middle. Fred Klaassen pushes it to long on for a single.
Full, on off. Forced to long on for one.
Fired on middle and leg. Worked towards short fine leg for one.
Tossed up, on off. Drilled to long off for one.
Beaten! Fuller, just outside off. It turns away and goes past Fred Klaassen's attempted defense.
A single as this is pushed to long on.
Tossed up, outside off. Philippe Boissevain is beaten as he looks to block.
Two wides! Down the leg side and Fred misses the flick. The man at short fine leg dives and stops the ball. The batters cross over once.
Who will bat next? It's Fred Klaassen.

OUT! CASTLED! Rashid Khan takes his team a step closer to the victory line! Flatter, on middle and leg. Saqib Zulfiqar goes for the pull but is hurried by the pace of the ball. It sneaks under his bat and hits the stumps.
Rashid Khan is back into the attack.
On a length, around off. Pushed past covers for one. 53 needed in the last 6.
Full and down the leg side. Saqib Zulfiqar misses the flick and Gurbaz does well to dive to his left and gather it.
FOUR! Thrashed away! Short and outside off. Saqib Zulfiqar hammers it past mid off and gets a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to cover.
Length ball, on off. Pushed past cover for one.
FOUR LEG BYES! Runs for Netherlands! Length and on the pads. It goes down the leg side and takes a bit of pad on its way. Gurbaz' dive cannot stop it from going to the fence.
Length ball, lands outside off and jags back in. Philippe Boissevain goes for the drive but it goes past the inside edge.
A single as this is pushed past cover. This is all but done for Netherlands.
Short and outside off. Cut away to deep cover for one.
Just past the off pole! Fuller, around off. Saqib Zulfiqar gets forward to block but the ball zips past the outside edge and just past the off pole too.
This starts on leg and turns down the leg side. Saqib Zulfiqar misses the flick. Wide called.
Full, on off. Pushed through mid on for one.
Tossed up, wide outside off. Philippe Boissevain looks to block but it goes past the outside edge.
Single as this is pushed to long off.
On a length, around off. Pushed to cover. 69 needed in the last 8.
Philippe Boissevain walks in next.

OUT! RUN OUT! That is brilliant by Rahmanullah Gurbaz! Length ball, on middle and leg. Saqib looks to flick it away but gets hit on the pads. There is an ambitious appeal by the bowler for LBW but the umpire is not interested. They look to sneak in a leg bye but Gurbaz charges in from behind the stumps and dives forward to take the bails off. The TV umpire is called in and the replay shows that Gorlee is miles out.
Another dot as Saqib Zulfiqar digs this wide yorker to point.
Fuller, lands outside off and comes back in. Saqib Zulfiqar gets the toe end while looking to drive.
Back of a length, outside off. Saqib Zulfiqar punches it to covers.
Length ball, on off. Blocked out.
Beaten! Tossed up, outside off. Boris expects some turn while looking to block but it goes straight and beats the outside edge.
Full, on off. Pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on off. Saqib Zulfiqar goes for the drive but gets it away off the inner half to long on for one.
Darted on the pads. Worked to the leg side.
A single as this is pushed past point.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this inning. Mujeeb Ur Rahman is back on.
Fuller, on middle. Boris Gorlee looks to drive it down the ground but gets the leading edge to covers.
Full in length around off, nipping in, Saqib Zulfiqar tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. End of a top over by Yamin Ahmadzai.
Saqib Zulfiqar is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! A much-needed breakthrough for Afghanistan. Yamin delivers it on a length around middle, it skids on with the angle, Pieter Seelaar doesn't cover the line and leaves a big gap as he attempts to work it on the leg side. He misses the ball goes through to shatter the stumps. 71 needed off 61 balls and the task gets tougher for the Dutch team.
Lands it on a length around off, skidding off the surface, Boris tries to push it through covers but gets an inside edge. It rolls to square leg and they cross.
Angling in from a length around middle and off, Gorlee pushes it down to mid on.
Width on offer outside off, Seelaar throws his bat at it and it goes off the bottom edge to third man for a single.
A touch short in length around off, Pieter Seelaar defends it from the back foot to point.

Drinks! This could go down to the wire. With Pieter Seelaar and Boris Gorlee just starting to switch through the gears and finding a few boundaries, things have gotten more interesting. But still, the required rate is almost 7 and it will not be an easy task against the Afghan attack. An interesting finish coming up. Yamin Ahmadzai is brought back by Afghanistan.
Quicker leg break, a touch short and outside off, Boris Gorlee once again tries to poke at it but gets beaten. 73 needed off 66 balls.
Googly, full and on off, Gorlee defends it with the spin to the leg side.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
Extra bounce and spin, outside off, Boris flirts inside the line and misses.
Wide! Spinning down the leg side, Boris tries to flick but misses.
Ooohhh...almost takes the edge. Full and flighted, around off and spinning away, Gorlee tries to defend but misses.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it in the gap at covers for a single.
Shortish and on off, hurrying onto the batter, Boris punches it without much timing to cover-point.
FOUR! Fine shot from the debutant. Another slower one, full and around leg, Gorlee picks it off his pads and whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary. 75 needed off 73 balls.
Slower one, full and around middle, Seelaar nudges it wide of short fine leg for a run. Wants the second run but he slips at the bowler's end.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Short in length and around middle, Pieter Seelaar stands back and pulls it in front of square leg for a cracking boundary.
Change in pace, full and on off, Seelaar keeps it out off the inner half. The ball brushes his pads and rolls away to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, pushed gently to cover-point for a quick run.
Wide! Attempted slower one but it's down the leg side, Gorlee tries to buy some cheap runs but fails to connect.
A long hop on middle, Boris gets back and miscues his punch down to long on, for a run. 86 needed off 78 balls.
On middle, knocked down to long on for one.
Ufff...extra bounce! This one kicks off after landing on a length around off, Pieter Seelaar tries to defend but is beaten on the outside edge.
Leans forward to a full ball and eases it down to long on for one.
Slightly short and on off, Pieter Seelaar goes back and forces it through cover-point for a run.
Full and on middle, Pieter defends it with the spin to the leg side.
Delivers it full and way wide outside off, Seelaar reaches out and drives it from the bottom part of his bat to deep cover. A single to end the over.
Full and on off, pushed back to the bowler off the front foot. Another dot.
Back of a length, around middle, Boris plays a mistimed pull shot towards mid on for a brisk single.
Tries to tap and run but the cover fielder quickly reaches the ball and Pieter Seelaar sends Boris back.
Fuller in length and outside off, Gorlee strokes it off the front foot to mid off.
Angling in from a length around off, Boris Gorlee presses forward and defends it near his front pad.
Wide! Short and way wide outside off, it's left alone by the debutant.
Full and on off, turning back in, Pieter Seelaar gets on the front foot and defends it on the leg side. 93 needed off 90 balls.
Loopy and full, around off, Boris lunges and gently pushes it with the spin to covers for one.
Flatter and short on off, Gorlee goes back and defends it down.
FOUR! A boundary against Rashid will give a truckload of confidence to the debutant. Full and flighted, wide outside off, Boris Gorlee stretches forward and thumps it through covers for a boundary.
Googly around off, Boris goes back and brings his bat down in time to defend it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on middle, defended back.
Rashid Khan (4-0-11-1) is back on.
Another ball, another dot. Naib pitches it up outside off, Pieter pushes it off his front foot to covers. The asking rate is now over 6 for the first time in this chase.
A gentle delivery, on a length around off, it's pushed with an angled bat to point.
Fuller and outside off, Pieter drives it through the line but finds mid off.
Width there outside off, short in length, Boris Gorlee steers it wide of point for a single. Opens his account on debut.
Serves it on a length and outside off, Seelaar plays late and guides it wide of backward point for a single. Under 100 needed now.
Slightly short in length and outside off, shaping away, Pieter Seelaar takes a stride forward and then makes a leave.
Play and a miss! This one turns the other way after landing outside off, Gorlee has no idea about it, just hangs his bat out tamely and gets beaten.
Skidding down the leg side, Pieter fails to flick and it goes off his pads to short fine leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
Beaten! A touch short and outside off, Seelaar tries to punch from the crease but it skids off the surface to beat the outside edge.
Fuller and on middle, Seelaar defends it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Full and around off, Boris Gorlee leans forward and defends it back to the bowler. A tidy over by Naib to maintain the pressure.
On a good length around off, staying a bit low, Boris Gorlee does well to keep it out safely.
Back of a length, around off, Gorlee defends it from the back foot to the off side.
Outside off, that is left alone for the keeper to collect.
Short and wide outside off, Boris tries to run it down to third man but misses.
On middle, a length ball, worked to square leg for a run.
Boris Gorlee is the new batter on his debut. Also, Gulbadin Naib is back on.

OUT! SOUND OF TIMBER! Mujeeb hits the jackpot and this is a massive wicket in the context of this match. This is nicely tossed up, landing around off and not turning much as Scott Edwards leans forward to work it around the corner. The angle made Scott play at it but the ball straightens to beat the edge of his bat and tickles the off pole. A big celebration from Afghanistan as a set batsman in Edwards departs. 102 needed off 114 balls.
Shortish and on middle, Scott gets back and helps it in front of square leg. Turns down the single.
FOUR! This is clever cricket! Fuller and on off, Edwards brings out the reverse-batted shot again and nails it behind backward point for a boundary, second of this over.
Quicker and skidding down, it's worked behind square leg for a single.
FOUR! Sliced away! Loopy again, full and outside off, Seelaar reaches out to drive it through covers but it takes the outer half and scoots wide of backward point for a boundary.
Flighted and full on middle, defended to the leg side.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is back on.
Past the stumps! Flatter ball, around off. Pieter Seelaar looks to work it past point but gets the inside edge past the stumps. They get a single though and now need 111 in 20 overs.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
Shorter and outside off. Edwards cuts it to deep cover for one.
Seelaar comes down the track to heave it away but gets it off the inner half past mid-wicket. Just a single then.
Loopy ball, on off. Pieter Seelaar gets forward to block it.
Loopy ball, on middle. Worked to long on for one.

A bit of shimmy down the track by Scott Edwards and he drives it wide of sweeper cover and calls for two. But the fielder gets across quickly and keeps it to one. Still, a good over for the Dutch as they got 8 from it.
A bit shorter, outside off. Pieter Seelaar pushes it through covers for one.
Loopy ball, on off. Eased to extra cover.
It's punched away to extra cover. The fielder dives to his right and deflects it towards mid off. The batters steal a single.
FOUR! Top, top shot! This should keep the scoreboard ticking. Tossed up, on middle and leg. Edwards gets low and sweeps it nicely to the square leg fence.
Loopy ball, on off. Pushed past cover for one.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Pieter Seelaar works it aerially towards long on for one. 100 up for Netherlands and they need to get going now.
Edwards gets a single by working this full ball to long on.
Another punch by Edwards but straight to the fielder at covers.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
Shorter, on off. Punched away by Edwards.
Pieter Seelaar dances down the track, doesn't really get to the pitch of the ball but works it past point for one.
Just 2 from that over! Tossed up, outside off. Driven to deep cover for one. 126 needed in 138 balls.
It's darted on middle and leg. Pieter Seelaar gets the inside edge onto the pads as he goes back to work it around. A stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Driven to short cover.
Another dot for Pieter Seelaar and he is in a shell now. Tossed up, on middle and leg. He gets hit on the pads while looking to block.
Flatter ball, on middle. Scott works it through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter, on off. Blocked out.

Good shout by Sharafuddin Ashraf! He fires it flat, landing on off and coming in with the angle. Pieter Seelaar is hit on the pads while looking to block. An appeal but replays show that he got an inside edge.
Tossed up, outside off. Pieter Seelaar blocks it well.
Loopy ball, on off, Seelaar watchfully defends it.
Shorter, on middle. Worked towards short fine leg. A bit of yes and no but they don't take the single.
Quick single. Pieter Seelaar works it towards mid on and sets off for a single. A fumble from that man allows the batters to cross with ease.
Darted on the pads. Edwards works it towards square leg for one.
Tossed up, on off, Pieter Seelaar defends it.
A single as this is worked to long on.
Flatter, on off. Blocked out.

FOUR! 50 for Scott Edwards and he has been the most impressive Dutch batter so far. A bit of innovation is what gets him there. Flatter, on middle. He reverse-paddles it past short third man for a boundary - first after the 14th over.
A single as this is pushed past covers.
Right on the money. Tossed up, on off. Blocked out by Seelaar.
Change in bowling. Debutant Shahidullah Kamal to have a go with the ball. He didn't make it count with the bat and would love to leave an impact here.
Fired fuller, around off. Edwards blocks it. Just 1 from the over.
Shorter, on off. Pieter Seelaar pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Seelaar comes down the track so Ashraf drags his length back a bit. This is blocked out with ease.
Nicely tossed this time, outside off. Pushed to cover by Pieter Seelaar.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out to the bowler.
Quicker, lands on middle and goes on with the angle. Pieter Seelaar gets hit on the pads while looking to flick.
Fired shorter, on the pads. Flicked to deep mid-wicket for one. Just 2 from the over. It's been 54 balls without a boundary now. Pressure is mounting.
Nice and full, on off. Pieter Seelaar gets forward to block it. He needs to rotate the strike more often now.
Shorter ball, outside off. Smacked back to the bowler.
Loopy one, on middle. A single as this is pushed to long on.
Fired fuller on middle and leg. Edwards looks to block but gets the inside edge down on the deck.
Flatter, on off. Edwards goes back to block it.
Tossed up, on off. Pieter Seelaar blocks it with ease from the crease. 140 needed in 28 overs.
Shorter one, on off. Blocked out.

Brilliant effort in the field by Najibullah Zadran! Shorter, around off. Scott goes for the cut but chops it past short third man. Zadran gives it a chase and dives to stop it just inside the ropes. The other fielder throws it back. Three taken.
Loopy ball, on off. Edwards pushes it to cover.
Loopy ball, on middle. Scott works it to the right of the bowler.
Flatter, on off. Defended with ease.
Full ball, on middle and leg. Pieter Seelaar blocks it from the crease.

NOT OUT! Tossed up nicely, outside off. Edwards drives it nicely past the diving cover fielder. Ghani runs to his left from long off and dives to stop the ball. The throw comes in and the batters look to take the third. Rashid gets in front of the stumps and then deflects the ball on the stumps through his legs. There is an appeal for a run out and it's referred upstairs. But the replay shows that Scott was well inside.
Appeal for a run out against Scott Edwards as he tries to steal the third run. The third umpire is referred but the replays find Scott safe and sound.
Flatter, on off. Scott Edwards goes back and blocks it.
Darted on middle and leg. Worked towards short fine leg for one.
Short and wide outside off. Pieter Seelaar looks to smash it away but gets no bat on it.
Fuller ball, on off. Blocked to point.

Flighted and on middle, some extra bounce there, Edwards gets forward to defend and does so from the upper half of his bat. Top over! Afghanistan are rushing through their overs here. 147 runs needed off 180 balls.
Quicker through the air, short again around off, Scott mistimes his shot back to the bowler.
Arm ball, around off and shorter in length, Edwards gets back and cuts it to point.
Loopy and full on middle, Scott lunges and defends it back.
Presses forward to a full ball and strokes it with the spin to deep cover for a run.
Fuller delivery around off, an arm ball, Pieter gets forward to defend but it takes the inner edge and rolls to square leg.
Quicker one, darted in around off, Edwards stayed back and defended it to the off side.
Full again, around off and turning away, Seelaar leans forward and pushes it with an angled bat through cover-point. A single is taken.
Forces a full ball down through mid off for a run.
Short and on off, punched to covers.
Quicker through the air, flat and short on middle, Edwards gets back to work it square on the leg side but the ball starts to turn away from him. He makes a late adjustment to jam it down.
Floated delivery, full and on off, Edwards drives with the spin to covers.
Too full on this occasion, on middle, Scott works it to square leg and keeps strike for the next over.
Arm ball, close to off, Edwards looks to defend but gets it away off the inner edge.
Fuller and outside off, Pieter Seelaar opens his account with a single as he drives it to sweeper cover.
Slower through the air, full and on off, Seelaar pushes it with an angled bat to cover-point. Scott wants a run but is sent back.
Fuller and a touch wider outside off, this time it has been driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted and full outside off, Edwards strokes it off his front foot to mid off.
Quicker through the air, full and on off, Seelaar is forward as he blocks it under his eyes. End of a successful first over from the spin maestro.
Loopy and full outside off, Pieter Seelaar lunges and pushes it to covers.

OUT! Given lbw! Rashid comes into the attack and does what's expected from him! Quicker through the air, flat and around middle, skidding off the surface, Bas de Leede is caught on the back foot as he attempts to keep it out. He fails to do so and is rapped on the pads. The appeal is made and the finger has gone up as well. Afghanistan continue to chip away at the wickets after the stand for the opening wicket. 153 needed more.

Drinks. Rashid Khan comes and he gets the wicket right away. Seems like every other match that he has been a part of. Good recovery by Afghanistan but the Netherlands have put on a decent show so far. The next 20 overs though will hold the key for both sides as we will see the pitch getting slower and the ball getting older. It will be a big challenge for the Dutch batters. Pieter Seelaar, the skipper, makes his way out to the middle.
Wide! Skidding down the leg side, Bas de Leede initially looks to flick but then withdraws his bat. Some extra bounce and the keeper fumbles. No extra run conceded though.
Googly, on the shorter side around middle, Scott moves back and works it through square leg for a single.
Full again, around off, it's nicely driven through mid off for a single.
Right on the button. Full and floated, around off, de Leede defends it off his front foot.
Now then. Big moment in the game as Rashid Khan is set to roll his arm over.
Another slower one, full and on middle, this time it's clipped in front of square leg for a single. 156 needed more off 204 balls.
Beaten! Slower one, on a length and outside off, staying low as well, Bas de Leede tries to drive but gets beaten.
Short in length and outside off, de Leede cuts it through backward point and scampers back for the second run. Good aggressive running between the wickets from the Dutch.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it towards mid on.
Close to off again, on a length and angling in, de Leede defends it near the surface.
Back of a length, around off and slower in pace, Bas de Leede defends it from the back foot to the off side.
Floated and full on middle, it's tucked behind square leg for a single.
Quicker and flatter, outside off, Edwards has forced it from the back foot to long off for one.
Short again, eased from the back foot through extra cover for a run.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched down to long off for one.
Tossed up around middle, it's turned towards wide mid on where Rashid Khan makes a fine stop.
Full and around off, pushed back past the bowler for a single as the ball went to long off. Sharafuddin Ashraf should have done better there.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Gulbadin Naib drags his length short and delivers it on middle, Scott hangs back and powers his pull shot through mid-wicket for a boundary. Spoils a good over.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Bas walks across the stumps and eases it through cover-point for a run.
Full again, way wide outside off, Edwards smashes it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Fuller and on off, defended solidly back to the bowler.
Wide! Slips a full ball down the leg side, Scott Edwards tries to flick but misses.
A touch short and on off, Scott taps it down from the crease to point.
Play and a miss! Short in length and outside off, Edwards throws his bat at it but makes no connection.
Yup, it's a maiden! Flatter again, full and around off, de Leede strides forward and defends it watchfully.
Uses his feet against a full ball and pushes it to mid on. Five dots, can he bowl a maiden?
Quicker and flatter on off, Bas walks forward and blocks it to the off side.
Presses forward to full ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Loopy and full, around middle, Bas de Leede gets forward and blocks it to short mid-wicket.
Full and on off, defended off the front foot.
Sharafuddin Ashraf is brought on now.
Chance for a run out! Angling down the leg side, Edwards tucks it towards short fine leg and looks for a run. He is sent back as the fielder misses his shy at the striker's end.
Full and on middle, knocked down to long on for a run.
Naib is limping back to his mark after getting hit on the shin. Hopefully, it is nothing that will hamper his bowling.
Ouch! This one has hurt the bowler. Full and around off, it's driven back firmly and Naib tries to deflect it onto the stumps at his end. He gets hit near the shin and is in some pain.
Fuller and on off, Bas de Leede is forward in defense.
Short again, pulled again. This one is aerial but goes safely to deep square leg. A single is taken.
Short and on middle, pulled across the line but straight to short fine leg.
Gulbadin Naib is back. Went for 9 in his first over.

Dropped! Beautiful delivery. Full and flighted around off, Bas de Leede is forward to defend but it takes a thick outside edge on its way back to the keeper. Gurbaz has not collected it. Mujeeb has his hands on his head. End of a fantastic over for Afghanistan.
Bas de Leede is the next batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! A sensational reflex catch by Gulbadin Naib. That ball was travelling. Mujeeb dishes out a full delivery outside off, Colin Ackermann rocks back to play the defensive shot but gets a thick outside edge. It rushes to the left of first slip where Gulbadin Naib reacts and gobbles it with both hands. This is a big breakthrough as Colin is the most experienced batter in Netherlands' ranks. 173 needed off 235 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Gulbadin Naib b Mujeeb Ur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Floated and full on middle, Colin uses his wrists and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Turning down the leg side, helped to the right of short fine leg. They crossed. 50 up!
Loopy and full on middle, flicked to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Eased away! Very ordinary bowling. Short and down the leg side, Scott Edwards goes down on one knee and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Dot ball. A gentle push to covers ends Powerplay 1 and Netherlands are off to a great start. They are 45 for 1.
Full, on off. Blocked out.

FOUR! This is poor bowling by Yamin Ahmadzai. Yes, he got the wicket but he is not consistent at all. Bowls it shorter and outside off. Colin Ackermann needs no second invitation as he cuts it past point for another boundary in the over.
Full and outside off. Colin Ackermann drags it past mid on for a couple. He goes for the drive but gets the toe end past mid on.
FOUR! A lovely stroke to get off the mark! Length ball, outside off. Colin Ackermann stays in the crease and throws his hands at it. He gets it through covers for a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Blocked out.
A solid defense from the crease by Edwards to end a tidy over from Mujeeb.
Around off, Edwards gets low, probably for the sweep but then works it towards square leg.
Full, on off. Edwards gets forward and plays it to covers.
Shorter, on middle. Pulled through square leg for a couple.

Rahmanullah Gurbaz is very excited there! Darted down the leg side. Scott Edwards looks to sweep it but seems to miss it. Gurbaz gets to his left and gathers it really well. There is a big appeal by him for a caught behind but the umpire calls it a wide.
Tossed up, on off. Driven to mid off.
Flatter ball, around off. Edwards blocks it from the crease.
Length ball, on off. Blocked out.
Who will bat next for the Dutch team? It's Colin Ackermann at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Gone! A wicket against the run of play for Afghanistan! The solid stand is broken and this is just what Afghanistan needed. Yamin Ahmadzai bowls a length ball and throws it wider this time. Musa Ahmed goes for the drive but doesn't reach the pitch of the ball. He ends up punching it aerially and straight to the man at cover. Shahidullah Kamal takes an easy catch to end the 32-run opening partnership.
Commentary.Howout: c Shahidullah Kamal b Yamin Ahmadzai

Commentary.Commentary: Nicely driven by Musa but this time the man at cover dives to his left to stop it.
Length, on the pads. Worked past mid-wicket for one. Good running and good cricket from Netherlands.
FOUR! That one deserved to reach the fence! Short and wide outside off. Edwards latches onto it and cuts it to the point fence.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
Change of ends. Yamin Ahmadzai gets the chance to run into the wind now.
Beaten! Well bowled. Mujeeb Ur Rahman tosses this a bit and throws it wider. Musa Ahmed looks to block but gets beaten.
Full, on middle and leg. Worked to short fine leg. Tell you what, the wind is so strong that even the camera is not stable!
A similar delivery but this time Edwards gets the inside edge back on the deck.
Shorter ball, around off. Pushed to cover.
Shorter, on middle and leg. Edwards goes for the sweep but gets the under-edge past short fine leg for one.
Flatter, on middle. Blocked out.
Change of ends for Mujeeb Ur Rahman. He is operating with the wind now.
Naib comes 'round the stumps and bowls a full one, on middle. Ahmed pushes it to cover. 9 from the first over of Naib. An expensive start for the former skipper.
On a length, on off. Blocked out from the crease.
FOUR! Pure timing on that! Naib errs again and bowls it too full, outside off. Musa Ahmed simply times it past the cover fielder to get a boundary.
On a length, around off. Pushed to covers.
Back of a length, on middle and leg. Edwards miscues the pull past square leg for one.
FOUR! Oh, top shot! Naib bowls a full one, wide outside off. Scott Edwards gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
Gulbadin Naib to bowl after just two overs from Mujeeb Ur Rahman.
On a length, on middle and leg. Musa dabs it near the deck on the leg side, looking for a single, but is sent back. Just a single from that over.
Length ball, wide outside off. Left alone and the ball doesn't carry to the keeper. It bounces on its way to Rahmanullah Gurbaz.
Full again but quite wide this time by Yamin Ahmadzai. Musa Ahmed decides not to chase it.
Nice and full, outside off. But Musa puts in a nice stride to drive it to cover. Well played.
This comes in after landing on a length, outside off. Scott Edwards goes for the cut but gets it towards third man for one.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Edwards blocks it from the crease.
Fired on middle and leg. Musa worked it towards square leg.
Fuller, on off. Blocked out back to the bowler.

FOUR! Edged but it runs away to the fence! Shorter and outside off. Musa Ahmed goes for the cut but gets the outside edge due to the extra bounce. The ball runs past short third man and despite the chase by the fielder, it reaches the fence.
A single as this is pushed to mid on.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman fires it full and on the pads. Edwards is lining up for the sweep shot but then decides to block it out.
Darted on the pads. Edwards works it past mid-wicket for a couple.
A good short one to end the over. This is right over the off pole and Musa Ahmed sways away from it. Well bowled.
A bit fuller and a lot straighter, on the pads. Musa turns it past square leg and gets a couple with ease.
Back of a length this time by Yamin Ahmadzai, angling across off. Musa Ahmed stays in the crease and blocks it with ease.
Fuller this time, on the fifth stump channel. Ahmed pushes it to point.
Much better. On a length, just outside off. Blocked out towards cover.
Length but wide outside off. Musa Ahmed leaves it with ease. Yamin Ahmadzai needs to get closer to the stumps here.
Shorter, around off. Pushed to covers. Just 2 from the over.
Mujeeb fires it on middle and leg. Musa Ahmed gets a single by working it past square leg. He is off the mark.
Fired in on off. Musa worked it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up, outside off. Musa puts in a nice stride to block it.
Fuller and on middle. Edwards works it towards long on for one.
Nice and full, on off. Driven to mid off by Edwards.
Will Mujeeb Ur Rahman bowl from the opposite end? Yup, he is ready. One slip in place...
On a length, wide outside off. Musa leaves this one with comfort. 5 from the first over.
Play and a miss! Back of a length, angling across off. Ahmed looks to push it away but is beaten.
On a length, around off. Punched past mid off for a single by Edwards.
FOUR! Edwards and Netherlands are off the mark with a boundary! A pacy ball, but down the leg side. Edwards simply helps it on its way to the fine leg fence.
On a length again, attacking the stumps. Edwards blocks it back to the bowler.
Yamin Ahmadzai starts on the money. A length ball, on middle. Edwards blocks it from the crease to the on side.
